goal: Establish a project-wide error handling strategy for Bitcoin Core
End recurring debates over error propagation across validation and subsystem changes
agreement: Concept support for establishing a formal error handling policy (sedited, josibake, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: contradicts existing codebase patterns and adds technical debt (ajtowns)
Contested objection: exceptions add unpredictable side effects and hidden control flow (l0rinc)
Contested objection: abrupt aborts risk wallet database corruption and lost funds (furszy)
Contested objection: global aborts break resilience patterns in P2P and RPC modules (mzumsande)

categories.name: docs
why: P2 because a shared standard resolves recurring debates stalling design decisions across pull requests
Unblocks consistent architectural guidance for open PRs across validation and other subsystems
